title: By the end of the Sub Strand, the Pronunciation and Vocabulary (Theme 13: Cultural activities)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the target sound (tr, sm, ch, ow, you) in the whole word, not only the first letter, and picks the word that has it.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Do "train" and "chain" sound the same?

steps: Say the sound alone, then in words.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child picks one.
Find the sound in a sentence.
contexts: music and drums at a ceremony

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child circles the word and says it back.

checks.question: Which word has the sound in "you": cute, cut, coat?
Which word starts with sm: snow, smoke, soak?
